QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` has `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` commented out. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also commented out.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the shipped config header has the threading macros (THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD) commented out, so a default build defines neither.
